issue_context.title: Improve server listening when 3000 already used
issue_context.body:
I believe we had it before but know the experience is quite frustrating if you already have a Nuxt server running.

It takes a random port and on top of it it is not reusing the last port when restarting the server:

https://volta.s3.fr-par.scw.cloud/Clean_Shot_2023_03_09_at_14_58_35_b46c3b8bd2.mp4
comments:
This should now be resolved in the latest version of `listhen`: https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/19578#issuecomment-1466023707.

You can update with `nuxi upgrade --force` (or it will be included in the next release of nuxt, which is imminent).

review_comments: I believe we could use it as default in listhen directly to use other fallbacks (actually this was behavior for trying 3000 + a range but behavior regressed as result of another fix)

Okay, so let's resolve upstream in `listhen` rather than here. 👍 

![whack-a-mole](https://media.giphy.com/media/ebITvSXYKNvRm/giphy.gif)
Agree, it seems to be a regression in [listhen](https://github.com/unjs/listhen) but thank you very much for the PR @RicardoErii ❤️
It's okay, so I close this PR?
Let's keep it open until https://github.com/unjs/listhen/issues/62 is fixed
